info.title: Peptide Library API
info.summary: Peptide research data, scientific literature and vendor information for developers.
info.description:
Peptide research data, scientific literature and vendor information from [Peptide Library](https://peptidelibrary.app).

**Research and education only.** Research and educational information only. Not medical advice, and not a recommendation to buy or use any substance. Many of these compounds are not approved for human use. The API never returns dose figures, regimens, reconstitution or injection instructions.

## Authentication
Research and study endpoints work without a key (limited per IP address). Vendor, product and price endpoints need an API key with the matching scope, sent as `Authorization: Bearer pl_live_…` (or `X-API-Key`). Create keys at https://peptidelibrary.app/developers/dashboard. Keep keys on your server: never put them in a browser or app bundle.

Scopes: `research:read`, `studies:read`, `vendors:read`, `products:read`, `pricing:read`.

## Rate limits
Keyed vendor, product and price requests count against your plan's per-minute and monthly limits (Free Developer: 60 per minute, 5,000 per month). Each response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; over the limit you get **429** with `Retry-After`. Anonymous requests are limited per IP address.

## Conventions
JSON envelopes: `{ data, pagination?, meta }` and `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor` → `pagination.next_cursor`). Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601; money is a decimal string in the listed currency, never converted. Research fields a profile doesn't document are the string `not_documented`; unknown vendor and price fields are `null`. Responses carry `ETag` (send `If-None-Match` for 304) and `X-Request-Id`.

## Prices and affiliate links
Peptide Library may earn a commission when you buy through these links, at no cost to you. Commissions never affect which offers are listed or their order. Prices are as last seen on the vendor's site; check the vendor before relying on them. Offers come only from vendors whose prices Peptide Library may share, are matched to a library profile and were seen on the vendor's site in the last 30 days.

get.description:
The API's version, documentation links and endpoints.

Scope: `research:read` (key optional).

Whether the API can read its data. 503 when the database is unavailable.

Scope: `research:read` (key optional).

Peptide research profiles with filters. `search` matches names, synonyms and aliases (fuzzy). Each result links to its canonical Peptide Library page.

Scope: `research:read` (key optional).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Name, synonym, alias or partial name.

parameters.name: regulatory_status
parameters.description: Regulatory class from the recorded FDA status.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to return for each item (`id` is always included). One of: id, name, also_known_as, categories, summary, research_topics, classification, fda_status, evidence, url, regulatory_status, content_reviewed_at, api_url.

get.description:
The full research profile: names, classification, mechanism, chemical properties, evidence (human and preclinical kept separate), safety, regulatory status and references. Dose figures are never included.

Scope: `research:read` (key optional).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Peptide id (e.g. `bpc-157`), name, synonym or alias. Aliases resolve to the canonical profile.

get.summary: Studies cited by a peptide profile
get.description:
Up to 12 cited sources with their evidence classification (regulatory label, controlled human trial, human study, secondary report, animal or lab, in vitro), identifiers and the editors' finding summary.

Scope: `studies:read` (key optional).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Peptide id (e.g. `bpc-157`), name, synonym or alias. Aliases resolve to the canonical profile.

get.description:
Studies with a PubMed, DOI or ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, de-duplicated across every profile, with the profiles that cite them.

Scope: `studies:read` (key optional).

parameters.name: peptide
parameters.description: Only studies cited by this peptide (id, name or alias).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to return for each item (`id` is always included). One of: id, title, publication_year, authors, journal, doi, pmid, nct_id, study_type, research_model, evidence_classification, evidence_classification_label, source_url, cited_by.

get.description:
One study by id (`pmid-…`, `doi-…` with `/` written as `--`, or `nct-…`) with each citing profile's summary.

Scope: `studies:read` (key optional).

One query across peptide profiles and Peptide Library's own educational content (site FAQ, per-peptide FAQs, articles, free courses). Dosing and commerce content is excluded.

Scope: `research:read` (key optional).

The Peptide Library vendor directory with search and filters. Ratings come from published reviews (verified = receipt checked by a moderator); order never depends on commissions or affiliate status.

Scope: `vendors:read`. Counts against your plan.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Where the vendor is based (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

parameters.name: ships_to
parameters.description: Only vendors that ship to this destination (country "US" or subdivision "US-CA"). Unknown coverage is left out.

parameters.name: product_category
parameters.description: Only vendors with live listings of this product type.

parameters.name: peptide

bearerAuth.description: API key from https://peptidelibrary.app/developers/dashboard, sent as `Authorization: Bearer pl_live_…`.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same key in an `X-API-Key` header.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique id of this request; quote it when you contact support.

ETag.description: Weak validator of the response data.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute on your plan (metered endpoints).

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the minute window resets.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or invalid (`invalid_parameter`, `invalid_cursor`).

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked (`missing_key`, `invalid_key`, `revoked_key`).

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the scope this endpoint needs, or the account is suspended (`insufficient_scope`, `account_suspended`).

NotFound.description: No such resource (`not_found`); peptide lookups include suggestions.

TooManyRequests.description: Over the per-minute or monthly limit (`rate_limited`, `quota_exceeded`).

Unavailable.description: A backend is temporarily unavailable (`backend_unavailable`); retry with backoff.
